conbody.p: In order to check the current energy consumption for each system of the vehicle, select Electric VehicleEnergy consumption on the screen.

li.p: Driving shows the total power and energy consumption of the driving motor’s driving energy and regenerative energy.
Climate shows the power and energy consumption which are used by the heater or air conditioner.
Electronics shows the power and energy consumption which are used by the vehicle systems including the cluster, infotainment system (speaker and navigation), headlamp, vehicle control unit, etc.
Battery care shows the momentary power and energy consumption which are used when:
Operating the battery conditioning mode to increase the battery temperature during winter to secure the charging performance as at room temperature.
Cooling down the battery temperature during summer to prevent over temperature of the battery.
